localResult: Authored bilingual skill descriptions/current numbers readable; capture limitations explicitly prevent complete visual-flow acceptance.
limitations: Synthetic levels, imported gear/pools and skill configuration do not establish earned progression or balance.
60 geometry assertions establish no document horizontal overflow and >=44px allocation height at five sizes; no claim of complete hit testing, safe areas, contrast, keyboard or a11y coverage.
Element screenshots are clipped around header/navigation or include black regions; do not prove full mobile/victory readability.
BUG063 is already fixed/accepted in5e4a038; current ScreenShell reserves HUD height in normal flow. These screenshots alone do not establish a new overlay regression or its cause.
Runtime performance and independent design/QA remain open.
